claims.text: For each piece of the screen, Flutter builds widgets, then lays them out (sizes and positions), then paints; build and layout can interleave (e.g. list rows built during layout).
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: resources/architectural-overview; resources/inside-flutter (building widgets on demand)

claims.text: In layout, constraints go down, sizes go up, and the parent sets the position; a widget chooses its size within its parent's constraints.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md ('Constraints go down. Sizes go up. Parent sets position.')

claims.text: Center takes the space it is given (when bounded) and positions its child in the middle; the child picks its own size.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md (Center examples); Flutter API: Center/Align

claims.text: ProductListScreen's FutureBuilder returns Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()) while waiting and Center(child: Text(...)) on error; each product is a ListTile with title Text(name) and trailing Text(price).
A ListView gives each child its width; ListTile places trailing at the end of the row and title at its start.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs / SDK source: ListView (tight cross-axis), ListTile layout

claims.text: Resizing the browser window changes the constraints given to the app, so layout runs again and the spinner stays centred with the same size.
claims.source_hint: refs/flutter-website: ui/layout/constraints.md; Flutter web window resize

claims.text: Resizing the window changes the space available, so layout (and then paint) runs again with new positions, while what the widgets describe stays the same.
Paint needs layout's results and layout needs build's tree, so the phases run in that order.
claims.source_hint: Flutter SDK rendering/binding.dart drawFrame (flushLayout before flushPaint)

claims.text: The Scaffold gives its body the space below the AppBar; a Center in the body takes that space.

scripts/up.sh (needs the flutter command) builds the app, served at http://localhost:8081; the refresh FloatingActionButton sits in the bottom-right corner (endFloat default) and reloads the products, showing the spinner while waiting.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: scripts/up.sh; product_list_screen.dart:27, 46-48, 68; Scaffold default FAB location
